newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Vneshekonombank drafts MinFin official.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Vneshekonombank drafts MinFin official.

text.p: Russia's Vneshekonombank (VEB), the state's foreign debt agent, has drafted a top Finance Ministry official as first deputy bank chairman, the bank said on Tuesday.
The bank appointed Vladimir Dmitriyev, formerly deputy head of foreign credit and foreign debt department at the Finance Ministry, as first deputy chairman, it said in a statement.
Dmitriyev was part of the Russian delegation which conducted a road-show for the recently-launched $2 billion sovereign Eurobond.
Anatoly Zabaznov, formerly head of the bank's foreign debt department, was appointed deputy chairman, as part of the move to improve state debt and foreign trade operations, VEB said.

VEB is currently finishing work on reconciling Russia's debt to the London Club of commercial banks creditors. VEB has so far reconciled 80 percent of Russia's $35 billion debt to the club. The debt must then be reconciled by the commercial banks.
